label: kizuna_ecology_c_02
text: I see you’ve already registered 100 species of\nPokémon to your Pokédex for me![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_c_03
text: Wow! Little Pokémon! Big Pokémon! Whoa, you\neven have data on Pokémon of this specific size?!\r\nSo much data! SO MUCH TO ANALYZE![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_c_04
text: Ah...sorry about that. I got a little excited there.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_c_05
text: My Pokémon research is moving forward at a\ngreat pace thanks to your efforts.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_c_06
text: Here, take these. Consider it my way of saying\nthanks.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_c_07
text: You’re a natural at this Pokémon catching thing,\naren’t you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_c_08
text: For your next goal, let’s aim for 200 species![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_c_09
text: I know that’s a tall order, but keep tossing those\nPoké Balls and don’t give up![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
